content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text addresses a challenger’s footed covenant-origin chain pressed against Matthew 1:20 and resolves it by the sentence’s own words rather than by chain-against-chain footing.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"D2 vs C1 (Matthew 1:20): UNDERDETERMINED -- the challenger's covenant-origin analogy is footed (1 Chronicles 28:6, Acts 1:8) but the sentence's own words state the source of what is in the womb; answered in [CR3] LINK 2.","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"“never verse by verse” — one reading bars using a single sentence's own words to answer a footed chain; the other reading bars only demanding a contrary stating verse.","why":"By treating the single sentence’s own wording as the decisive answer to the challenger’s footed chain, the judge text uses a verse-by-verse/stating-verse test instead of weighing chain against chain by footing."}
